settings.title: LeetCode
settings.description: Your public LeetCode profile. Pulse reads problems solved, your streak and recent accepted problems. It never asks for a password or token, and it never changes a health score.
settings.usernameHint: The public username in your profile URL.
settings.disconnectBody: Pulse deletes this profile's stored LeetCode data from the phone. Your health data stays.
settings.privacy: Public profile data only. Pulse never asks for a LeetCode password, cookie or token.
settings.notConnectedBody: Connect your public profile to see your practice in Pulse.

screen.activityNote: LeetCode's calendar counts submissions, not problems: a problem accepted twice counts twice here, and a wrong attempt counts too. This view is never problems solved.
screen.refreshFailed: Last refresh failed. Showing the data from {{ago}}.
screen.syncFailedNoData: Could not load your LeetCode profile. {{error}}
screen.notConnectedBody: Connect your public profile in Settings to see your practice.

error.invalidUsername: Enter a valid LeetCode username (letters, numbers, _ or -).
error.notFound: No LeetCode profile with that username.
error.private: This profile does not share its stats. Make the profile public in LeetCode, then try again.
error.rateLimited: LeetCode is rate limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.blocked: LeetCode blocked this request. Try again later.
error.server: LeetCode is having trouble. Try again later.
error.timeout: The request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
error.offline: Could not reach LeetCode. Check your connection and try again.
error.malformed: LeetCode returned data Pulse could not read. Try again later.
error.storage: Could not save the profile on this phone. Try again.
